The '''Republic Interceptor''' '''TX-130 ''Saber''-class fighter tank''', otherwise known as the '''IFT-X''' or '''Republic fighter tank''', was a maneuverable, fast-attack [[Tank/Legends|tank]] used by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and their [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone]] [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|forces]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Features==
[[File:TX-130S-concept_art.png|thumb|left|180px|A cut-away view of a TX-130.]]
The TX-130 [[Saber-class assault tank|''Saber''-class]] fighter [[Tank/Legends|tank]] was equipped with twin [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] and a large payload of [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missiles]].<ref name="DB" /> Some models had a [[Beam cannon turret/Legends|beam cannon turret]] on top.<ref name="BFI guide" /> With a limited speed boost, Jedi [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] could remove themselves from tight combat situations, and then use the TX-130S's powerful optical zoom on the main turret to eliminate vehicles and personnel from a safe distance.<ref name="SW:CW" /> Some were also equipped with an on-board [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2]] unit. The [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] tank's [[Armor/Legends|armor]] was light enough to maintain its maneuverability,<ref name="DB" /> allowing the fighter tank to be used in an anti-vehicle and [[Soldier/Legends|infantry]] support role.<ref name="BFI guide" />

Constructed by [[Rothana Heavy Engineering/Legends|Rothana Heavy Engineering]], the TX-130 was 8.2 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in length with a top speed of 320 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] per [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]].<ref name="wizards" /> It had room for 2 passengers, 750 [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]] of cargo, and supplies for one [[Standard day/Legends|day]].<ref name="TCWCG" />

The top turret of the tank had an open-cockpit for the gunner, while the tank's rear door was also a weak spot, and if any heavy weaponry landed a hit there, the damage would be more severe than any other section of the vehicle.

==History==
[[File:Saber_tank.jpg|thumb|left|The wreck of a ''Saber''-class tank during the [[Siege of Saleucami/Legends|Siege of Saleucami]].]]
The TX-130S was sometimes referred to as the "[[Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Jedi starfighter]] of the ground."<ref name="DB" /> During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the versatile fighter tank saw action on [[Planet/Legends|planets]] such as [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], [[Rhen Var/Legends|Rhen Var]], [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]], [[Thule/Legends|Thule]],<ref name="SW:CW" /> and [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]].<ref name="Republic">''[[Star Wars: Republic: Siege of Saleucami]]''</ref> Many notable Jedi piloted fighter tanks during the Clone Wars, including [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]], and [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]] who used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and superior skills to get the best out of these maneuverable craft. In the hands of these Jedi, these tanks proved a match for many Separatist armored vehicles.<ref name="SW:CW" />

The tank was phased out of service shortly after the proclamation of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], and was replaced by stronger variants, such as the [[TX-130T fighter tank]] and the [[2-M Saber-class repulsor tank/Legends|2-M ''Saber''-class repulsor tank]], both of which having a different paint and aesthetic to the Republic's variant.<ref name="SW:CW" /> However, production continued in secret, with several hundred models being sold to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].

These vehicles were used by Rebel forces during the [[Battle of Turak IV]].<ref name="TBoT4" />

==Behind the scenes==
The TX-130 first appeared as one of the usable vehicles in [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (video game)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'']] [[Star Wars video games|video game]].

A first LEGO version of the tank (LEGO STAR WARS - 7679 Republic Fighter Tank) was released in 2008 and a second version (LEGO STAR WARS - 75182 Republic Fighter Tank) was released in 2017. A third version (LEGO STAR WARS - 75342 Republic Fighter Tank) was released in 2023.
